submission.noteMarkdown: First Agent under Owner delegation grants narrowly scoped WRITE crates/vibe-core/src/manifest/migration.rs solely private fn replay_edits -> pub(super), plus pure parent wrapper in already-authorized manifest/mod.rs. Root inspected exact primitive: checks ordered/nonoverlap spans, original token equality, untouched text copying; preserve whole body and existing refusal/profile/package/apply behavior. Wrapper must return existing typed refusal and carry correct governing scope; no apply authority/framework. Grant exact READ crates/vibe-core/src/environment/mod.rs, environment/layout.rs, package_ref.rs, rel_path.rs (all verified). Prefer actual existing configured-root owner if those definitions expose it. If none exists, validated project-relative spec-root context supplied by trusted host composition is permitted with layout::current_specs_root default; manifest/URI cannot grant an arbitrary root or escape it. Prove non-default root actually used by shared parser/lookup validation, not a decorative argument. State parser-level injected configuration boundary, not implemented project-settings/CLI override. Do not modify global layout settings/current consumers, add a settings writer or silently drop configured-root requirement. Same B1, exact remaining write ceiling; all ID/roles/duplicate/path/closure/epoch checks before mutation and comment/value preserving actual replay remain required.
